title: Admin Sign-In - Accessibility Test Plan (WCAG 2.1 AA)
overview: Comprehensive accessibility test plan for Admin Sign-In page covering WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for sign-in form, email/password inputs, validation errors, authentication feedback, session management, and responsive design.

testCases.title: Sign-In page has proper heading structure
testCases.wcagCriterion: 2.4.6 Headings and Labels, 1.3.1 Info and Relationships
testCases.preconditions: Admin navigates to Admin Portal Sign-In URL
steps: 2. Verify H1 exists for page title
3. Use screen reader heading navigation (H key)
4. Verify heading hierarchy is logical (no skipped levels)
expectedResults: Page has exactly one H1 heading
Heading hierarchy logical (H1 → H2 if sections exist)
Screen reader can navigate by headings

testCases.title: Sign-In page has proper landmarks
steps: 3. Verify form is within main content area
expectedResults: Skip link present if navigation exists

testCases.title: Email input field has proper label
testCases.wcagCriterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 4.1.2 Name Role Value
steps: 3. Verify label programmatically associated (for/id or aria-labelledby)
4. Verify placeholder is supplementary, not sole label
6. Use screen reader to verify label announced
expectedResults: Screen reader announces 'Email' when field focused

testCases.title: Password input field has proper label
testCases.wcagCriterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 4.1.2 Name Role Value
steps: 6. Use screen reader to verify label announced
expectedResults: Screen reader announces 'Password' when field focused

testCases.title: Sign-In form keyboard navigation
testCases.componentElement: Sign-In form (Email, Password, Sign In button)
steps: 2. Verify focus moves to Email field
4. Verify focus moves to Password field
6. Verify focus moves to Sign In button
7. Verify tab order is logical (Email → Password → Sign In)
expectedResults: Tab order follows visual layout: Email → Password → Sign In

testCases.title: Focus indicators visible on all form elements
testCases.componentElement: All interactive elements on Sign-In page
steps: 1. Tab to Email field — verify focus indicator visible
2. Tab to Password field — verify focus indicator visible
3. Tab to Sign In button — verify focus indicator visible
5. Verify focus indicator at least 2px thick
6. Verify focus not obscured by other elements
expectedResults: Focus indicator visible on Email field
Focus indicator visible on Password field
Focus indicator visible on Sign In button
Focus indicators clearly visible and not obscured

testCases.title: Sign In button keyboard accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Sign-In page with valid credentials entered
steps: 2. Verify button has accessible name 'Sign In'
expectedResults: Button role announced by screen reader
testCases.postconditions: Sign In button keyboard accessibility verified

testCases.title: Sign In button disabled state accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Sign-In page with empty or invalid fields
steps: 2. Verify Sign In button is disabled
3. Verify disabled state has aria-disabled='true' or disabled attribute
4. Verify disabled state announced by screen reader
5. Verify visual indication of disabled state
6. Fill valid email only — verify button still disabled
7. Fill both valid fields — verify button becomes enabled
expectedResults: Disabled state has disabled attribute or aria-disabled='true'
Visual styling clearly shows disabled state
Button enables when both fields valid

testCases.title: Email inline validation error accessible
steps: 2. Move focus away from email field (blur)
4. Verify error has role='alert' or aria-live
5. Verify error linked to input via aria-describedby
8. Use screen reader to verify error announced
expectedResults: Inline error message appears for invalid email
Error announced immediately by screen reader
Error linked to email field via aria-describedby
Error suggests correction (e.g., 'Enter a valid email address')

testCases.title: Authentication failure error accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin enters incorrect credentials and submits
steps: 1. Enter valid email but incorrect password
3. Verify error message appears: 'Invalid email or password'
4. Verify error has role='alert' or aria-live='assertive'
5. Verify error announced immediately by screen reader
6. Verify error does NOT reveal which field is wrong
expectedResults: Error message: 'Invalid email or password' displayed
Error announced immediately without user action
Error does not reveal which credential is wrong (security)
Focus moves to error or remains on form

testCases.title: Account locked error accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin account is locked due to multiple failed attempts
steps: 1. Attempt login with locked account credentials
4. Verify message announced by screen reader
5. Verify message provides reason and guidance
expectedResults: Account locked message displayed with reason

testCases.title: Inactive/suspended account error accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin account is inactive or suspended
steps: 2. Verify access denied message appears with reason
4. Verify message announced by screen reader
expectedResults: Access denied message with reason displayed

testCases.title: Successful login redirect accessible
steps: 3. Verify loading state announced if present
5. Verify Admin name and role visible in header
6. Verify new page has proper heading structure
expectedResults: Loading state announced via aria-live if applicable

testCases.title: Session expiry message accessible
steps: 4. Verify message has role='alert' or aria-live
5. Verify message announced by screen reader
expectedResults: Redirect to Sign-In page on session expiry

testCases.title: Password show/hide toggle accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Sign-In page with password field visible
steps: 3. Verify toggle has accessible name ('Show password' / 'Hide password')
expectedResults: State change announced to screen reader
aria-pressed or aria-label updates on toggle

testCases.title: Form submission with Enter key
testCases.preconditions: Admin has filled in valid credentials
steps: 3. Press Enter key while in password field
5. Verify same behavior as clicking Sign In button
expectedResults: Enter key submits form from any input field
Behavior identical to clicking Sign In button

testCases.title: Text contrast meets WCAG AA
testCases.componentElement: All text elements on Sign-In page
expectedResults: All normal text has 4.5:1 contrast minimum

testCases.title: UI component contrast meets WCAG AA
testCases.componentElement: Input borders, button boundaries, focus indicators
steps: 4. Verify all UI components have 3:1 contrast minimum

testCases.title: Mobile viewport accessible
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Sign-In page on mobile device

testCases.title: Required fields indicated accessibly
steps: 1. Verify both Email and Password fields marked as required
2. Check for aria-required='true' or required attribute
5. Verify not relying on color alone for required indication
expectedResults: Both fields have required or aria-required='true'

testCases.title: No keyboard traps on Sign-In page
steps: 1. Tab through all elements on page
2. Verify focus cycles through all interactive elements
4. Verify no element traps keyboard focus
5. Verify focus can leave the page (browser chrome)

testCases.title: NVDA screen reader compatibility
testCases.preconditions: NVDA screen reader enabled, Admin on Sign-In page
steps: 1. Navigate to Sign-In page with NVDA
6. Submit form and verify feedback announced

testCases.title: JAWS screen reader compatibility
testCases.preconditions: JAWS screen reader enabled, Admin on Sign-In page
steps: 1. Navigate to Sign-In page with JAWS

testCases.title: Information not conveyed by color alone
testCases.componentElement: Error states, required indicators, button states
testCases.preconditions: Admin is on Sign-In page with various states visible
steps: 1. Trigger validation error — verify text label present (not just red border)
2. View required field indicator — verify asterisk or text (not just color)
3. View disabled button — verify visual distinction beyond color
4. Test in grayscale mode — verify all states distinguishable
expectedResults: Errors have text labels, not just color
